summary: Users launch portal templates to run AAP job templates: auto-generated templates sync with identical forms, custom templates come from Git with a config file linking them to a job template; several custom templates can map to one job template, assigned by RBAC to users of different skill levels.
questions: What is the difference between auto-generated and custom portal templates?
Can different users get different forms for the same job template?
Can I import portal templates from a Git repository?
